```
def dp_pca(X, eps):

    mu = dp_mean(Xc, eps/2)
    sigma = dp_std(Xc, eps/2)
    Xn = (Xc - mu)/sigma
    U, S, Vt = np.linalg.svd(Xn, full_matrices=False)
    return Xn @ Vt[:6].T
```
